segments.name: Americas
segments.description: Develops, produces and markets industrial process fluids and chemical management services for heavy industrial and manufacturing customers in the Americas.
segments.evidence: The Company has three reportable segments: (i) Americas; (ii) EMEA; and (iii) Asia/Pacific.

segments.name: EMEA
segments.description: Develops, produces and markets industrial process fluids and chemical management services for heavy industrial and manufacturing customers in Europe, the Middle East and Africa.
segments.evidence: The Company has three reportable segments: (i) Americas; (ii) EMEA; and (iii) Asia/Pacific.

segments.name: Asia/Pacific
segments.description: Develops, produces and markets industrial process fluids and chemical management services for heavy industrial and manufacturing customers in the Asia/Pacific region.
segments.evidence: The Company has three reportable segments: (i) Americas; (ii) EMEA; and (iii) Asia/Pacific.

revenueModel.text: Industrial and manufacturing customers pay Quaker Houghton for specialty process fluid products and Fluidcare chemical management services, sold mostly directly by employees, with the balance through distributors and agents.
revenueModel.evidence: The majority of the Company's sales worldwide are made directly through its own employees and its Fluidcare TM programs, with the balance sold through distributors and agents.
